As the witness reaches toward a girl, she is dragged back into the flames.
Demons form a circle around a confined individual in flames.
Demons compel a person to sing and dance before throwing and whipping him.

lemma: Witness hand burns and develops worms
reported_properties: When reaching to help, the witness feels or sees her own hand burst into flames and fill with worms.
The witness cannot see or feel the guide and fears she has been abandoned.

lemma: Invisible rope draws witness to voice
reported_properties: A rope around her waist pulls her toward a threatening voice and later loosens.

lemma: Heart of Hell identified in descent
reported_properties: The guide calls the destination the heart of Hell, said to contain religious ministers.
Witness and guide follow a dark alley to a barred gate that opens for entry.
A former pastor preaches while pretending to hold a Bible.
The guide says a preacher exercises the same favoritism in Hell as he had on earth.
Snakes bind a singer's arms and torso during speech and singing.
A confined singer reports that his body exploded on landing after tunnel descent and worms emerged.
Snakes torment a former minister's wife while she invokes her prior status.
A demon beside a pastor appears to him in the form of a woman.
A pastor gestures as though drinking and appears drunk; the narration says that behavior continues from earthly life.

lemma: Demons accuse woman of missed calling
reported_properties: Demons accuse a woman of lost souls as a consequence of disobeying a ministerial call.
Two men fight each other and others join while demons torment them with flames.
A man in the fight says his earthly competition for money and congregants persists after death.

lemma: Spirits of living people seen in cells
reported_properties: The witness reports seeing people still alive on earth appearing bound in infernal cells.
The guide explains living people's appearances in cells as slavery to sin and troubled conscience.
Demons consult an open book while speaking in words the witness cannot understand.
The narrator explains that demons whose attempts to confuse ministers fail are confined and tortured by other demons.
The escort shines light into darkness so the witness can see those he had heard.
The people appear trapped in separate personal torments and cannot communicate with one another.
The people call to the witness for help and apparently do not perceive the angel beside him.
While the witness discusses his own judgment, thousands of others are sent to Hell.

lemma: Short experienced duration despite earthly days
reported_properties: The witness reports fifteen minutes in the other realm despite several days passing on earth.

lemma: Rear cells branch into V-shaped rooms
reported_properties: Behind the front cell tiers, spaces widen into V-shaped formations and farther rooms.

subclass_name: Beings embedded in objects or fabric
reported_properties: In the simulated revival cell, the chairs and other props themselves are demonic beings.

lemma: Cell scenery changes with treadmill effect
reported_properties: The interior setting shifts while the victim runs without escaping a physically small enclosure.
A cloven-hoofed being with talons descends through the roof of the revival scene.
A professor is seen writing on a blackboard; the narrator connects the scene to the ideas he taught on earth.

lemma: Open enlarged cell furnished with chair
reported_properties: The witness sees a cell assigned to himself, larger and open, containing something like a dentist's chair.
The arrival of a presence is accompanied by shaking ground and audible or felt footsteps.
Two men in red garments take the witness by either arm after she sees her own body.
The witness recognizes two angels through gold writing on their foreheads in the heavenly judgment scene.
During the man's immersion the witness cannot hear him, though he screams when removed.
The witness reaches toward a girl but her hand passes through the girl's hand.
The witness says people she saw in Hell are still alive on earth, accompanying her stated temporal impression.
The witness sees a great gulf and souls trying to climb upward toward the Father.
The witness describes fallen angels chained in darkness by the lake of fire.
Flames are described as piercing but giving no light within a dark lake.
The witness says Hell is expanding during the scene.
A mighty Death Angel appears at the right side of the dark valley.
A command to stop is accompanied by shaking throughout the place.
The escort lets go, but the witness remains hovering rather than falling.
A woman acts as if reading Scripture and preaches John 3:16 inside her assigned place.

lemma: Summit with group accused of neglect
reported_properties: A summit contains several men associated with a case of refused aid to a sick woman.
Two beautiful women appear in a demonic assembly, and the narrator describes male imitations as well.
A man's efforts to remove fire-worms are followed by their multiplication.

lemma: Witness sees own likeness on carriage
reported_properties: The witness sees a person identical to himself seated where the carriage's center seat had been empty.
Different lights illuminate successive afflicted persons amid broader darkness.

lemma: Residents do not respond to visitor
reported_properties: Recognized relatives and acquaintances fail to hear the witness calling to them.
The carriage stops at a location called the judgment platform where deeds are displayed.

lemma: Several days felt in seventy minutes
reported_properties: A journey experienced as days is said to occupy seventy minutes on earth.
The horned being tending the lake holds a spear ending in seven blades.
Another figure called a king of Hell approaches during the lake tour.
The witness cannot catch two people walking about three hundred yards ahead despite trying.

lemma: Giant armored person with head wound
reported_properties: A very tall armored figure is seen with sword, shield and forehead wound; identity is supplied by another speaker.

lemma: Rock at end of tunnel as viewing place
reported_properties: The witness and guide sit on a rock at the tunnel terminus to view suffering people.

lemma: Lake radiates heat at a distance
reported_properties: The witness feels the heat of a fire lake from far away.

lemma: Passage by waters to chained doors
reported_properties: On the second journey the witness passes moving waters and a tunnel to large chained doors.
Thousands move toward Hell with bowed heads, tattered clothing, and chains.
The witness says he was made unaware of being Christian during the infernal episode.
The demons curse God throughout the encounter.
The witness distinguishes the odor from demons from the wider smell of burning flesh and sulfur.
When outside the cell, the witness hears an immense multitude crying in the darkness.
The witness says he knew a fiery pit was ten miles distant and three miles across.
The dark atmosphere permits only limited illumination from a large fire.

lemma: Demons crush skull and threaten dismemberment
reported_properties: Returned to the cell, he is subjected to skull crushing and an attempt to pull off arms and legs.

lemma: Creatures police rim of fiery pit
reported_properties: Large beings line the pit edge and push people who climb upward back into flames.
Among many wall-bound entities the witness reports spiders about five feet tall.
The witness reports grasping the permanence of his confinement with unusual certainty.
Departure occurs by an upward tunnel-like whirlwind from the depth to above earth.
Previously overwhelming wall demons appear comparatively small in the guide's presence.
Nearby human bodies lie motionless and apparently without breath beside the fire pool.
The witness describes red, orange and blue fire on his burning arms.
Laughter from one torturer elicits answering laughter from others across the region.
Liquid fire pours from throat and chest cavities when bodies are dragged onto banks.
The narrator describes the tormenting beings as never stopping for sleep, food or rest.

lemma: Walls click and scream when gripped
reported_properties: The insect-composed wall produces clicking and screeching sounds as the witness climbs.

lemma: Living interpit ground pulls witness down
reported_properties: Ground separating the pits draws the witness downward while he tries to escape.

lemma: Volcanic rock differs from living terrain
reported_properties: The volcano is hard, hot and jagged rock in contrast to the insect-filled ground.
A large angry face appears in a fireball and smoke plume moving around a volcano.
The river is harder to move through than the earlier fire pool because its liquid is thicker.
The current draws the witness into flames as he struggles to surface.
An unidentified voice tells the witness twice to stay in the river's middle.

subclass_name: Bodies and channels of destructive fluid
reported_properties: The river becomes narrow, fast and winding before widening and slowing near a large pool.
A circular opening showing blue sky and trees vanishes when the witness touches it.

lemma: River course resets after apparent exit
reported_properties: After touching the window, the witness is returned to the upstream beginning of the river.

subclass_name: Bodies and channels of destructive fluid
reported_properties: Downstream the witness perceives a much larger fire body described as an ocean.
